app.title: AI-assisted PCB design for KiCad 10
app.author: ofrzeta
app.description: An AI plugin that assists with schematic capture and PCB layout in KiCad 10.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and install the plugin into KiCad 10
Open a simple schematic and use the AI assistant to generate a component placement
Verify the generated netlist is syntactically correct
Run a layout generation and check for design rule violations
